items.title: Thursday Dinner
items.where: Linger Lodge, 7116 85th St Ct E, Bradenton, FL 34202
items.note: Dinner for anyone in town on Thursday, including our visiting Aussies. Let Jeff know if you'd like to join.

items.title: Umpire Clinic
items.where: Premier Sports Campus, 5895 Post Blvd, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34211
items.note: On-field drills in teams led by senior umpires — field, goal, and boundary accreditation stations.

items.title: Umpire Meeting
items.where: Even Hotel Sarasota-Lakewood Ranch, Osprey Room, 6231 Lake Osprey Drive, Sarasota, FL 34240
items.note: You're on your own for dinner after the Clinic; tea, coffee and sodas at the meeting. We'll review the tournament rules in detail and the points of emphasis, and hand out gear to anyone with gear coming to them. Coaches and observers stay back afterwards to go over how observations will run on the weekend.

items.title: Umpire Team Picture
items.note: Be on site in time to be in the picture.

items.title: Game Day 1
items.where: Premier Sports Campus, 5895 Post Blvd, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34211
items.note: Games on the hour — make every effort to start on time. Coaches meet at Umpire Central at 6 pm to review observations.

items.title: Awards Fete
items.where: Even Hotel Sarasota-Lakewood Ranch, Osprey Room, 6231 Lake Osprey Drive, Sarasota, FL 34240
items.note: Dinner provided, with non-alcoholic drinks (anything else you'll need to source yourself). Presentations start around 8:30 (maybe sooner): accreditations (boundary, goal, field and coach), two special awards, then Sunday's finals assignments — field and goal, plus boundary for the last final. Boundary and timer/scorekeeper for the other finals will be announced then if ready, otherwise posted in the Umpire Tent Sunday morning.

items.title: Game Day 2
items.where: Premier Sports Campus, 5895 Post Blvd, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34211
items.note: Same rules as Saturday. Record any assignment changes on the big sheets at the tent.

items.title: Finals
items.where: Premier Sports Campus, 5895 Post Blvd, Lakewood Ranch, FL 34211
items.note: Finals teams gather at Umpire Central for a team picture and go out as a group. Medals as you come off the field; field umpire medals at the closing ceremony.

items.title: Thank You Dinner
items.where: Ford's Garage, 295 N Cattlemen Road Unit 1, Sarasota, FL 34243
items.note: For everyone still in town. Aussie guests and Tent Royalty are our VIPs. Let Jeff know if you plan to attend.
